title: Motion Equity Partners takes over microfluidics specialist Capsum
summary: Chanel has found a buyer for Capsum, in which it had held a majority stake since the 2010s. On Tuesday, October 20, investment fund Motion Equity Partners officially announced its acquisition of a majority stake in the company, which specializes in the formulation of high-end skincare, makeup and fragrances. Sébastien Bardon, Capsum's founder and CEO, and his management team are also reinvesting in the company. Chanel will remain a minority shareholder in the company. Founded in 2008,...
